newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine automobile sales up 26.48 pct in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Philippine automobile sales up 26.48 pct in 1996.

text.p: Total automobile sales in the Philippines grew 26.48 percent in 1996 to reach 162,095 units as compared with 128,162 units registered the previous year, the Chamber of Automotive Manufacturers of the Philippines Inc (CAMPI) said on Friday.

CAMPI secretary-general Mario de Grano told reporters that sales of vehicles, including cars, buses and trucks, could grow further this year due to the rising per capita income of Filipino families as well as to support the need of growing businesses.
Passenger cars accounted for 54.89 percent of the total sales or 88,977 units of the vehicles sold; while commercial vehicles, covered 45.11 percent, or 73,118 units.
Leading the market was Toyota Motor Phils, a unit of Toyota Motor Corp, followed by Mitsubishi Motor Phils, a unit of Mitsubishi Motors Corp and Honda Cars Phils Inc, a unit of Japan's Hondo Motor.
